ns2:course.label: Capstone Project
ns2:course.description: This course is intended for students to demonstrate their proficiency, creativity, ability, and authority as a professional in Scenic Technology. Students will implement the knowledge gained in courses taken and production to prove their understanding and skills in a culminating project. 1 undergraduate hour. No graduate credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 2 hours in separate terms. Prerequisite: Enrollment by permission of area chair.
